hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Elements at even indices must share remainder x and odd indices share distinct remainder y.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Calculate the cost to adjust each value to candidate remainder r modulo k.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Evaluate all distinct remainder pairs and pick the minimal total cost.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Computes remainder transition costs per parity partition and minimizes over distinct pairs.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all per-element increments directly without modulo grouping is unbounded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Retains frequency cost tables of size k for both parities.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Groups elements by index parity and checks optimal distinct remainder assignments.
